cards.name: Fblthp, Lost on the Range
cards.oracleText:
Ward {2}
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
The top card of your library has plot. The plot cost is equal to its mana cost.
You may plot nonland cards from the top of your library.

cards.name: Fblthp, the Lost
cards.oracleText:
When Fblthp enters, draw a card. If it entered from your library or was cast from your library, draw two cards instead.
When Fblthp becomes the target of a spell, shuffle Fblthp into its owner's library.

cards.name: Fblthp: Completely, Utterly, Totally Lost
cards.oracleText:
When you planeswalk to this plane and at the beginning of your upkeep, create a Map token. (It's an artifact with "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery.")
Whenever chaos ensues, draw two cards, then discard two cards. Untap up to three lands.
